clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath Orgrimmar, Searing Blade cultists hold Incantations from the Nether, a grimoire of demonic magic. Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras seek its fel knowledge for the Forsaken.

The Searing Blade is a subterranean sect tied to the Shadow Council, working in the fiery tunnels of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar's red stone streets. Its cultists prize Incantations from the Nether, a spellbook of demonic rites given by agents of the Burning Legion. They use its secrets to plot treason in the Orcish capital. Word of the tome has reached the royal quarters of Undercity.
